title: Test does not assert quantity=0 or price=0 behaviour

finding.claim: Test does not assert quantity=0 or price=0 behaviour
finding.recommendation: Include a test case with qty=0 or price=0 to ensure the Cart handles those inputs without crashing or producing unexpected totals.

 from shop.cart import Cart, Item
 
 def test_empty_cart_totals_zero():
     cart = Cart()
     assert cart.total() == 0
+
+def test_total_multiplies_price_by_quantity():
+    cart = Cart()
+    cart.add(Item(price=250, qty=3))
+    assert cart.total() == 750
